نكتسح (form VIII)
# نَكْتَسِحُ (naktasiḥu) /nak.ta.si.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
# نُكْتَسَحُ (nuktasaḥu) /nuk.ta.sa.ħu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
# نَكْتَسِحَ (naktasiḥa) /nak.ta.si.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
# نُكْتَسَحَ (nuktasaḥa) /nuk.ta.sa.ħa/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
